title: Barsatu Yadav v. State of U.P.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Manoj Kumar Gupta, J.; Manish Kumar Nigam, J.
disposition: Writ disposed; liberty to avail Clause 6.5 remedy.
headnote: A writ challenging a recovery citation for electricity dues was disposed of with liberty to the consumer to pursue the efficacious alternative remedy under Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The Court did not examine the merits of the citation.
facts: Barsatu Yadav petitioned the Allahabad High Court against a recovery citation dated 31 July 2024 issued by respondent no. 3 for electricity dues. Counsel for the Electricity Department submitted that the petitioner had an efficacious remedy under Clause 6.5 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The Division Bench accepted that submission and did not go into the correctness of the citation or the dues claimed.

holding_units.holding: A writ against a recovery citation for electricity dues is not entertained on merits where Clause 6.5 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005, furnishes an efficacious alternative; the petition is disposed of with liberty to avail that remedy.

not_decided.point: Validity and quantum of the recovery citation dated 31.07.2024
not_decided.note: Merits of the electricity dues and the citation were not examined.
